Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 6
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the question and compared the directors’ ages at the time of each film’s release (37 vs. 31) instead of comparing their birth years to determine who is older overall. Despite having the correct birth years (Nunzio Malasomma 1894, Don McGuire 1919), the Planner concluded Johnny Concho had the older director and even stated McGuire was “older by 6 years,” which is incorrect. The correct comparison shows Malasomma (born 1894) is older, so the correct film is One Minute to Twelve.
